VBO:0201161.summary: Friendly and watchful in the breed standard, the long-haired Saint Bernard shares the calm-to-lively character of its short-coated counterpart. Swiss hospice dogs guarded the Great St Bernard Pass and helped travelers lost in snow and fog. The modern breed developed from regional farm dogs; coat length distinguishes this variety.
VBO:0201161.shortDescription: A friendly, watchful Swiss companion in the standard, with a shared hospice rescue history and a longer coat.

sources.title: Saint Bernard: Official FCI Breed Standard
sources.evidence: Whole FCI61,2016 English standard: companion/watch/farm use; friendly, calm-to-lively and watchful normative character shared by both coat varieties. Hospice history documents guarding and rescue in snow/fog, with regional farm-dog ancestry of modern breed. GeneralAppearance and Hair explicitly distinguish long-haired variety. Detailed anatomy, long heavy natural tail, color/required white markings support morphology. No coat-length-specific temperament, individual suitability, health or guarantee of rescue performance.

VBO:0200924.summary: Lively, alert and keen to work in its breed standard, the Mudi is a Hungarian herder used with large and difficult livestock. The same standard describes courage, watchfulness and adaptability, and records work in wild-boar drives. Blue-merle denotes a coat pattern; these working tendencies belong to the breed rather than its color.
VBO:0200924.shortDescription: A lively, alert Hungarian herder in the standard; blue-merle is a coat pattern, with the same working character.

sources.title: Mudi: Official FCI Breed Standard
sources.evidence: Whole FCI238,2023 English standard: herding use with large/difficult livestock and wild-boar battue, plus lively/courageous/watchful/keen-to-work/alert/adaptable normative character. Morphology includes wedge head/prick ears, slight body length, sloping topline, short head/limb coat and dense wavy body coat. Cifra(Merle) covers diluted pigmented patterns on listed base colors. Ash(blue) is separately listed. Natural full medium-set tail and repose/alert carriage are literal, although stump also allowed. No color-specific personality, health, genetic claims or parent-trait transfer.
